name: Habaki
source:
Habaki went to the priestess academy of sorts along with Ishika and Honori.
However, Habaki could never keep up with Ishika and Honori's incredible talent
in spite of how much she studied or trained. Embittered, she joins up with
Aragami when he offers her power.
translation:
